name: CADCraft

limitations: - OpenGL: tested on AROS One 1.3, which has only Mesa's software renderer,
so AUTO uses CPU there. GPU works and is several times slower than CPU.
- Tested from a Shell with scripted edits; typing, menus, the file
requester and the question about unsaved changes were tested on mainline
AROS only.

aros-x86_64-abiv1-pc.sdk: x86_64 mainline ABIv1 SDK of nightly 2026-11-10
limitations: - OpenGL: with Mesa's software renderer AUTO uses CPU. Hardware OpenGL
drivers have not been tested in this release.

aros-aarch64-abiv1-raspi.system: AROS on Raspberry Pi, AArch64 ABIv1 (mainline nightly 2026-11-10)
aros-aarch64-abiv1-raspi.sdk: Raspberry Pi AArch64 ABIv1 SDK of nightly 2026-11-10
limitations: - Tested in an emulator only, not on a physical Raspberry Pi, and from a
Shell with scripted edits.
- OpenGL has not been tested on Pi hardware, so AUTO uses CPU. GPU has not
been tested in this release. Save your work before you try it.
- Every change redraws the whole window. On slow machines and in emulators
the interface follows with a delay.
- The drawing area is drawn by the interface renderer, not by CADCraft's own
GPU canvas, so large drawings pan and zoom slowly.
- All drawings share one window, and floating panels stay inside it.
- The control server (--control) and 3D mice are not available.
- No automatic updates: install new versions with the AROS package manager
or by unpacking the new archive.
- Not tested on AROS in this release: DWG files written by other programs,
plotting and printing from the window, AutoLISP routines, external
references, pictures in drawings, and keyboard layouts other than the US
one.
- Text in scripts other than Latin may be shown as boxes when no font for
it is installed.
- The MCP server (cadcraft-cli mcp) has been tested only for its handshake
on AROS.
